recipe.title: Air Fryer Buffalo Chicken Wrap
recipe.summary: A crispy buffalo chicken wrap with cottage-cheese ranch, celery sticks, and Quest Nacho Cheese Protein Chips.
recipe.story: A quick game-day-style lunch that gives busy moms a full crunchy meal, familiar flavors, and no sad desk-lunch energy.
recipe.serving_size: 1 buffalo chicken wrap | 1 bag Quest Nacho Cheese Protein Chips | 1 cup celery sticks | 2 tablespoons cottage-cheese ranch
ingredients: 18 ounces Member's Mark Grilled Chicken Bites
6 Mission Carb Balance Soft Taco Flour Tortillas
6 tablespoons Frank's RedHot Buffalo Wings Sauce
6 individual bags Quest Nacho Cheese Protein Chips

ingredient_sections.title: Buffalo Chicken Wraps
items: 18 ounces Member's Mark Grilled Chicken Bites
6 Mission Carb Balance Soft Taco Flour Tortillas
6 tablespoons Frank's RedHot Buffalo Wings Sauce
6 individual bags Quest Nacho Cheese Protein Chips

instructions: Blend the cottage cheese, 2% milk, and ranch seasoning until completely smooth. Set aside.
Place the grilled chicken bites in a single layer. Work in batches if necessary.
Air fry for 6 to 8 minutes, shaking halfway through, until hot and 165°F.
Transfer the chicken to a bowl. Add Frank's RedHot Buffalo Wings Sauce and toss to coat.
Warm the tortillas for 10 to 15 seconds in the microwave so they fold without tearing.
Place 1/2 cup romaine down the center of each tortilla. Add 3 ounces buffalo chicken and 2 teaspoons blue cheese crumbles.
Drizzle 1 tablespoon cottage-cheese ranch inside each wrap. Fold in the sides, roll tightly, and place seam-side down.
Serve each wrap with 1 cup celery sticks, 1 bag Quest Nacho Cheese Protein Chips, and 1 tablespoon cottage-cheese ranch for dipping.
freezer_storage: Do not freeze assembled wraps, cottage-cheese ranch, romaine, celery, or Quest chips.
Cool the chicken completely and freeze it separately without the buffalo sauce.
If four servings remain, use a gallon-size freezer bag. If fewer than four servings remain, use a quart-size freezer bag.
Remove as much air as possible, seal, and freeze flat for up to 3 months.
reheating_instructions: Thaw the chicken overnight in the refrigerator.
Air fry at 375°F for 4 to 6 minutes, shaking halfway through, until the chicken reaches 165°F.
Toss the hot chicken with fresh buffalo sauce, then assemble with fresh tortillas, romaine, blue cheese, and cottage-cheese ranch.
tips: Use 1 tablespoon ranch inside the wrap and reserve 1 tablespoon for dipping.
Freeze only the chicken so the fresh ingredients keep their proper texture.
